rationale_one_line: Scrapling is a speed-and-scale web-scraping framework whose headline is a structural trick (self-healing element relocation), so ClickHouse's near-black canvas with electric-yellow stat-number voltage carries the benchmark credibility while SCHEMATIC lets a node diagram show the relocation loop as the hero beat.
writing_tone_notes: Engineer-first, build-in-public peer. Plain declarative. Frame it as keeping scrapers alive as the web changes, not novelty. Contractions where natural. No superlatives; the broken-selector contrast carries the praise. Yellow reserved for the one stat number and the close accent, ClickHouse-style.
do_rules: Open on the maintenance problem the tool solves, not the star count.
Reserve the star-velocity metric for the X caption only; scenes stay qualitative or use the speed benchmark.
Use one big yellow stat number ClickHouse-style for the proof beat.
Make the diagram the visual hero: show the relocation loop, at least one orbit move.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the X caption.
No reuse of scene phrases (heals itself, re-finds it, site redesigns, write it once) in the caption or Why-this-one.
No superlatives and no fastest-ever claims; cite the benchmark range honestly.
No framework repeat of MANIFESTO (most recent on 2026-06-01).
